paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesikta Rabbati, piska “Et Korbani”; Hyman reports that he is cited in the Arukh, entry קקבטין, as Huna bar Yaki.[^1]

notes.text: The whole OYW Pesikta Rabbati 16 paragraph begins with “Et Korbani” and has the untitled Huna bar Yuko explaining הקקבטין. Hyman’s Huna bar Yaki form and explicit Rav in the heading remain as supplied, without transferring that title into the digital witness. The Arukh entry קקבטין and its reported Yaki form remain Hyman’s report, without fresh Arukh collation or identity harmonization.
